newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends weaker on import deals.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends weaker on import deals.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed slightly lower against the dollar on limited commercial demand for the U.S. currency by importers, dealers said.
The U.S. unit closed at 55.73 to the rupee after opening at 55.71, a shade softer than Friday's close of 55.70.
"The dollar rose to a high of 55.78 on limited import covering demand before falling back," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 16.25 percent after opening at 16, dealers said.
